uploadDescription: Select a file or drop it below to get started.
supportedFormatsLabel: PDF files only. Password-protected PDFs are not supported.
localOnlyNote: Processed on your device. Your PDF is never uploaded.
pagesDescription: Drag page previews to reorder them, or use the buttons to move, rotate, and remove pages.
emptyPagesDescription: Undo your last change or reset the pages to start again.
dragPagesHint: Drag the handle to reorder. You can also use the move buttons or focus a handle and press ↑ or ↓.
exportDescription: Save the pages in the order shown above. Your original PDF stays unchanged.
invalidPdfError: This PDF could not be read. Try another PDF file.
encryptedPdfError: This PDF is encrypted. Unlock it before organizing its pages.
noPagesError: Keep at least one page before generating a PDF.
exportFailedError: The PDF could not be generated. Try again or choose another file.
